column1: # French diacritic-fold table (D-436) - base letter -> every real accented variant, so a token typed
# without its accent ("ecole") still reaches the correctly-spelled word ("école"), both live while
# typing and at autocorrect/split-repair time. hints.tsv (same folder) picks one representative
# symbol per key for the AltGr long-press hint; this file keeps the complete set per base letter.
